# Judging guide: is this job a sensible recommendation for this graduate?

You see a final-year university student in Malaysia (their degree programme and the modules they have passed) and
several job ads. Grade each job for this student:

2 = good fit: a fresh graduate of this programme with these modules could reasonably apply, and would meet most of
    what the job asks for
1 = partly: a related field, but the job needs notable skills the modules don't cover, or it is a step above a
    graduate role (a few years' experience)
0 = not a fit: a different field, a clearly senior or managerial role, or most requirements unrelated to the modules

Judge only from the programme, the modules and the ad. Ignore salary, company name and location. Grade each job on
its own; the order of the jobs means nothing.

Network Infrastructure (NI) provides the essential building blocks of modern communications networks, powering innovation in cloud, AI, automation, broadband, data centers, and secure networking. As part of our commitment to developing future talent, we are investing in the next generation of engineers through the Network Engineer Graduate Program. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn Why Join This Program? • Structured Learning: Guided pathways covering network fundamentals, automation, cloud, AI/ML, IP technologies, security, and software development. • Hands-On Experience: Labs, simulations, network design/troubleshooting, automation projects with Agentic AI, and real customer projects. • Mentorship & Coaching: Regular sessions with technical experts and business leaders, plus peer learning. • Certifications: Industry-recognized certifications sponsored by Nokia. • Cross-Functional Exposure: Job rotations across multiple teams and functions. • Long-Term Growth: Potential for permanent placement in Nokia's Network Infrastructure organization based on interest, strengths, and business needs. Your Journey Phase 1: Learning & Development (First 6 Months) A structured program of self-paced learning, instructor-led sessions, and hands-on activities covering network automation, cloud, AI/ML, and internet technologies. You'll build programming fundamentals (Python, REST APIs, JSON), learn security and performance monitoring, earn certifications, and strengthen communication and presentation skills through mentoring, technical challenges, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Phase 2: Job Rotations (Next 12 Months) Up to two rotations across areas such as Network Integration, Customer Solution Design, Automation & Digitalization, Project Management, Customer Engineering, Service Delivery, or Network Transformation Programs — working on real projects alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional teams. Key Skills And Experience • What We Are Looking For • Recent Bachelor's/Master's graduates or final-year students • Curiosity, learning agility, and passion for technology • Interest in automation, AI, cloud, networking, or software development • Strong problem-solving, communication (English), and teamwork skills • Self-driven, adaptable, and proactive Preferred (not required): exposure to computer networking, Python, cloud technologies, automation, APIs, data analytics, or AI/ML through coursework, internships, or personal projects. • What You Will Gain • A strong foundation in modern networking technologies • Practical experience in automation, cloud, and AI • Industry-recognized certifications • Real-world project experience and cross-Nokia networking • Multiple job rotations and accelerated career growth • Ready to Start Your Journey? pairs.title: Data Engineer
pairs.ad: As a Data Systems Specialist / Data Engineer, you'll be responsible for:- 1. Data Warehousing: • Managing and maintaining the data warehouse to ensure data integrity and availability. • Implementing data warehousing concepts and architecture, such as Ralph Kimball methodologies. • Integrating data from various sources, ensuring seamless data flow and consistency across systems. • Developing and maintaining data integration processes to support business operations. 2. ETL Development: • Building and maintaining dynamic and complex ETL processes. • Extracting, transforming, and loading data into the data warehouse. 3. Data Modelling and Design: • Designing and creating data models that facilitate efficient querying and reporting. • Ensuring data accuracy and consistency. 4. Performance Tuning and Optimization: • Ensuring data systems perform efficiently. • Monitoring query performance. • Fine-tuning data retrieval processes. 5. Data Governance and Security: • Implementing data governance policies and ensuring data security. • Implementing access controls. • Managing data lineage and compliance. 6. Report and Dashboard Development: • Ability to understand or create interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations for business users. • Empowering business users with self-service reporting. Qualifications: • Minimum of 3 years solid in Data Warehousing, Data Engineering, or Business Intelligence Development (Must). • At least 3 year(s) of experience with SQL, Data Integration, Implementing Data Quality Checks and Data Modelling (Must). • Proficiency in MS SSIS, Azure Data Factory, SQL, MS SQL Database, Azure DevOps, and Data Integration Tools (Must). • Experience with Power BI, ServiceNow, Qlik, Tableau, C, C++, C#, Python, or R (Beneficial). • Solid understanding of Ralph Kimball methodologies (Must). • Experience with ETL development, Data Integration, and Data Warehousing (Must). • Ability to analyse complex, large data sets, data models, data mining, and segmentation techniques for a global organization (Must). • Fluent in English (Must). • Certificates from Microsoft in Azure Data Platform, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, Database, ETL Tools, and SQL Server/Cloud Services (Preferred). • Self-starter, principled, and driven to do the right thing for the organization (Preferred). Bonus points for: • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. • Knowledge of Medical industries or Medical Manufacturing business domains.

With the group's 3 Gigawatts of power capacity deployed and under development globally, Bitdeer holds a decisive advantage in the AI era: the massive energy, physical infrastructure, and compute foundation required to run intelligence at global scale. Operating across strategic international hubs, including Singapore, Malaysia, the United States, and Europe, we build on one core promise: One Cloud, Infinite Possibilities. Our Two Core Missions • Transforming Hyperscale Power into Useful AI: We take the extreme complexity of gigawatt-scale energy grids, liquid-cooled data center topologies, and low-latency networking fabrics, and turn that raw physical power into accessible, high-performance AI Cloud that directly drives real-world intelligence. • Building an Integrated Full-Stack Cloud Platform: We engineer the complete software layer, spanning bare-metal provisioning, managed Kubernetes, distributed training pipelines, high-throughput AI Inference engines, and Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) with serverless APIs, empowering enterprises to seamlessly train, fine-tune, deploy, and serve next-generation AI intelligence. Why Start Your Career at Bitdeer AI? We don't just look at the infrastructure layer, we build across the entire value chain for our full-stack cloud. At Bitdeer AI, you will architect the actual backbone of global artificial intelligence. From foundation-level hardware orchestration and low-latency Inference systems to upper-layer MaaS platforms and AI Agents environments, you will solve high-scale systems challenges that few companies on Earth have the power capacity to attempt. Your work will directly power the global AI ecosystem, from ambitious startups and elite research institutions to global enterprises.
